outcome: sensitivity of transabdominal vs transvaginal ultrasound in detecting specific ultrasound signs
cohort: 15 patients diagnosed with caesarean scar pregnancy at a tertiary referral center between March 2010 and February 2015.
finding: Transvaginal ultrasound is more sensitive than transabdominal ultrasound in detecting specific ultrasound signs of Caesarean scar pregnancy, but transabdominal ultrasound can still be a useful adjunct diagnostic tool.
